acproj_estimate

Source: R/models-acproj.R
acproj_estimate.Rd

Fit age-cohort models

Usage

acproj_estimate(
  cases,
  pyr,
  noperiod,
  startage,
  pGOF = 0.05,
  linkfunc = "power5"
)

Arguments

cases

data.frame with number of cases in nagg-year period by ascending age groups in row.

pyr

data.frame with observed and projected population size in nagg-year.

noperiod

Number of 5-year periods in historical data.

startage

Youngest age group to include in the GLM. Default (NULL) picks based on mean cases.

pGOF

Model selection criteria of p-value of goodness-of-fit.

linkfunc

Link function. Default is "power5". Can be one of "log", "sqrt", or "identity".

Value

A list().
